purpose: Define human-readable documentation as a generated or maintained projection of the same canonical semantics used by machine readers, preserving Topics, ownership, structure, behavior and provenance without becoming a second source of truth.

value.dual_form_rule: Human-readable and machine-readable representations both belong to the documentation system.
value.source_rule: Machine-significant facts originate in structured canonical semantics.
value.topic_rule: Human documentation preserves Topic groupings and multi-Topic context.
value.structure_rule: Containment, relation, ownership, authority and dependency remain distinguishable.
value.behavior_rule: Operations, events, flows and causality are described from their structured definitions.
value.prose_rule: Human prose may explain and contextualize but cannot silently add missing machine-significant semantics.
value.sync_rule: Generated human docs should be reproducible from the canonical model where practical.
